newsitem.title: UK: Delta gains after Salomon upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Delta gains after Salomon upgrade.

text.p: Shares in cables and engineering group Delta Plc rose on Thursday as analysts at Salomon Brothers raised the stock to "buy" from "hold," dealers said.
The stock was up 6 1/2p at 353 1/2 by 1247 GMT in volume of 143,930 shares. Delta shares dropped to a low of 319p on February 18, its lowest in over five years.
Salomon said the upgrade reflected prospects for a recovery in the UK housing, which is its largest single market, and a belief that the market had exaggerated the threat from currency movements.
In January Delta said it was cutting about 90 jobs in a restructuring after losing a major contract at its copper wire operation.
